## History

As a child, Hammond was struck by a stump thrown by his father. Later in life, he was hired by [Fiske](../character/fiske.md) to paint a religious message on a freight shed. He operated a small sawmill in a river clearing and took [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) into his home for over two years before he eventually died.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V.
